tasks.title: Implement Logic-inspired DAW control bar
tasks.description: Build a polished, compact control bar inspired by the supplied Logic Pro X reference image (transport: Play, Record, Loop; LCD/position display; Tempo; Snap; clean neon gradient styling; interactive hover and active states).
acceptance_criteria: Uses existing egui framework (no second GUI framework added)
Transport buttons reference real branding/icons assets (not just generic shapes)
Layout follows Logic Pro X control bar structure: branding label | transport group | tempo/snap group
Interactive hover (hot pink) and active (gold) states implemented
Clean divider instead of ugly thick gradient strip
No footer bar; workspace uses central panel
Build passes (cargo build --release succeeds)
Visual inspection performed against reference image
tasks.notes: Control bar rebuilt with dedicated module (control_bar.rs). Buttons currently use clean text labels (Play, Record, Loop, Tempo, Snap) with branded colors rather than rendered SVG icons; SVG rendering setup remains pending. Build passes. .exe rebuilt and pushed. Next agent should verify whether user requires actual SVG image rendering or if current branded-button design satisfies visual requirements.
